_readme: Mount Etna start-up montage, the same mechanism as /load_screen/earth: frames play in this order from this folder, and adding a photograph plus a line here is the whole change. hold_ms is how long a frame holds, fade_ms the dissolve; the page fetches this file fresh on every start, so an edit shows on the next load.
_sources: 01, 02 and 04, 05 are GeoID's own; 03 is NASA and is credited as such. Esri's World Imagery is deliberately NOT here even though the viewer draws it: it is licence-conditional, and a start-up screen is shown to every visitor rather than chosen by one.
